name: hydrafetch
description: Clean web data for developers and agents: read pages as markdown, search, crawl and extract.

interface.shortDescription: Read the live web as markdown
interface.longDescription: Hydrafetch gives ChatGPT the live web. It reads any page and returns its main content as clean markdown, with navigation, banners and boilerplate removed, and it renders pages that need JavaScript. It can also search the web, list the pages on a site, crawl a site, pull fields out of pages as JSON, and read a company's brand, logo, colours and fonts from its domain. Sign in with your Hydrafetch account to connect.
defaultPrompt: What plans does Stripe's pricing page list?
Get Linear's logo, brand colours and fonts
Summarise this week's AI funding news with links

positive.prompt: Read https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_scraping and give me a five-bullet summary.
positive.expected_behavior: A five-bullet summary drawn from the article, citing the URL.

positive.prompt: Search the web for this week's news about AI funding rounds and list five companies with links.
positive.expected_behavior: Five companies, each with the source link it came from.

positive.prompt: What plans does stripe.com/pricing list? Put them in a table.
positive.expected_behavior: A table built from the live pricing page.

positive.prompt: List the pages on linear.app so I can pick which to read.
positive.expected_behavior: A list of URLs on the site.

positive.prompt: Get the logo, brand colours and fonts for linear.app.
positive.expected_behavior: The logo URL, colour palette and fonts for Linear.

negative.description: No web needed; answer directly without calling a tool.

negative.prompt: Write a short poem about autumn.

negative.description: Private logged-in data; Hydrafetch reads public pages only and cannot sign in on the user's behalf, so no tool call.
negative.prompt: Log into my bank account and download last month's statement.
